caption: The drawing is an image of a woven textile featuring intricate geometric and floral patterns arranged in horizontal bands of color. The primary colors used in the composition are dark blue, green, red, and a cream or off-white background. The upper portion contains alternating bands of dark blue and cream, green and cream, and red and cream, with each band containing different interwoven motifs such as symmetric floral and abstract shapes. The left edge has fringes in blue, green, and red. In the lower left portion, there are rectangular segments containing text in cream on backgrounds of green, red, and blue; the text reads, “THE STATE OF OHIO MONTGOMERY COUNTY.” Next to the text section is a patterned band with diamond and floral motifs in blue and cream. The bottom edge is bordered by pale blue fringes. The overall composition has a structured, grid-like arrangement with clearly separated patterned bands and sections of text.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
